name: Kamata Genji
source:
The owner and building manager of the apartment complex where Shuichi and Nanami live. He also serves as the neighborhood association chairman.

He is friendly and approachable, and actively takes care of the building and its residents by inspecting the apartment's facilities, cleaning the garbage disposal area, and performing other maintenance tasks.

Because of this, Shuichi and Nanami also place their trust in him.

He is enthusiastic about neighborhood association activities and values his relationships with the local residents.

However, he sometimes gets carried away at drinking parties after neighborhood events. When drunk, he occasionally embraces married women from the neighborhood association's women's group, much to the displeasure of their husbands, who look on with sour expressions.

He also happens to be knowledgeable about the latest home electronics and frequently takes photographs at neighborhood association events using his newest digital camera.

However, he sometimes exhibits suspicious behavior...

[Translated from [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/11485]the official site[/url]]
